incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty ALERT fired: METRICS|metering_pipeline_delay > 10m for shard=7 (threshold=600s) — Pager ID P-9a2f. Please respond.

maria (oncall): acked, jumping in to triage — will gather blast radius.

sam (sre): oncall2 here, looking at consumer offsets and kafka consumer group.

devon (billing-eng): saw token mismatch alerts earlier today, could be related. no invoice holds yet.

alice (cs): any known customers impacted? I have a renewal call at 16:00 PST.

maria (oncall): quick snapshot: consumer group for shard-7 shows ~12h backlog, token_count diffs spiking for some customer accounts. not sure if miscount or duplicate ingestion.

sam (sre): running quick checks — querying backlog counts now:

```sql
SELECT shard, COUNT(*) AS backlog, MAX(received_at) as newest
FROM metering.ingest_events
WHERE shard = 7
GROUP BY shard;
```

sam (sre): tailing consumer logs to spot exceptions:

```
kubectl -n prod logs -f deploy/metering-consumer-7 -c consumer | grep -i "exception\|commit failed" --color=auto
```

devon (billing-eng): I have a small re-agg script to recompute tokens for a window: `scripts/recompute_tokens.py --start 2026-03-10T00:00Z --shard 7 --limit 1000` — can run after we stabilize processing.

maria (oncall): acked on PD, escalation to L2 (sam) complete. PD incident: https://pdt.inc/INC12345 — adding link to thread.

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty: incident INC12345 acknowledged by maria (oncall).

sam (sre): found repeated exception in consumer: `ValueError: negative token delta` when processing message id=abc123 — looks like a poisoned record that triggers a retry loop and stalls offsets. temp mitigation: skip poisoned offset and restart consumer for shard-7. will do rolling restart.

maria (oncall): restart initiated for metering-consumer-7. monitoring for reprocessing rate.

sam (sre): restart done. consumer came back healthy, processing rate jumped from ~40 msg/s to ~680 msg/s. backlog drain started.

devon (billing-eng): starting targeted re-agg for high-value customers only (to limit churn). running with `--dedupe=true` flag to avoid double-counting during transient.

alice (cs): copying draft customer note to #customer-notify. waiting on final impacted list before sending.

sam (sre): note for postmortem: consumer should tolerate malformed/negative delta messages and move them to quarantine topic instead of retrying indefinitely. adding TODO in infra backlog.

maria (oncall): mitigation summary: 
- restarted consumer to bypass poisoned message (hotfix)
- started targeted re-aggregation for affected window (billing-eng)
- scheduled full backfill + dedupe overnight (billing-eng + infra)
- handoff scheduled to sam at 21:00 PST; I'll remain on-call until handoff completes

maria (oncall): preliminary customer impact: ~0.8% of invoices in the last 24h show token delta >5% vs expected. most are small, but a subset (~0.04%) exceed 20% and flagged for manual review. no widespread invoice blocks at this time.

devon (billing-eng): I'll open invoice hold workflow if any >20% are confirmed after re-agg. capturing ledger audit logs to reconcile.

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Incident INC12345 status updated to MONITORING — PagerDuty: moved to monitoring state.

maria (oncall): moving to monitoring. adding incident doc: https://docs.redwood/incident/INC12345 — will update with timeline and root cause when known.

alice (cs): thanks all. please ping me immediately if any customers need outreach before 16:00. :thumbsup:

sam (sre): leaving note: follow-up actions -> quarantine bad messages, add heartbeat on consumer offsets, improve alert to include token-delta histogram. adding owners.

maria (oncall): acknowledged. I'll close the PD once the backfill finishes and diffs are under threshold.

(reacts: :eyes: from alice, :thumbsup: from devon)
